hook_text: Find the map of South America in under ten seconds. The trick is on the very first pages.
clip_script: Upington, the atlas speed challenge. Learner one flips page by page and is still searching. Learner two opens the contents page. The contents are in order: world maps first, then continents, then countries and provinces, each with a page number. To find a single town, go to the index at the back: it is in alphabetical order and gives the page and a grid reference. Contents for maps, index for places. Ten seconds!
visual_style: Whiteboard stopwatch beside an atlas, with the contents page listing world, continents and countries, then an index entry pointing to a grid square.
mood: Fast and playful, like a game show.
pacing: Race-like opening, clear steps for contents and index, then a winning finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and time yourself finding your home town in an atlas.
